episodes.title: Épisode 1
episodes.summary: When her daughter becomes a murder suspect, Hélène enlists the help of Vincent, a lawyer and an old flame who works to shed new light on the case.

episodes.title: Épisode 2
episodes.summary: Anya gives Vincent an unsettling account of the fateful night. Hélène and Vincent search for a man seen in Anya's photo - with dire consequences.

episodes.title: Épisode 3
episodes.summary: The police question a suspect and hit a dead end. After Anya's release, Hélène begins to doubt her daughter's integrity - and her own role as a mother.

episodes.title: Épisode 4
episodes.summary: As Anya's credibility wanes, Hélène talks to someone close to Kamal and must reckon with an appalling truth that will turn her life upside down.
